notes: Evidence run for the controller-bound reading, not a timing benchmark: one untimed warm-up per runner, then 3 sampled runs each, psutil sampling every 0.5s (corpus/cpu_sample.py).
root = the process the command started: pytest-xdist's controller (python -m pytest) or the rstest driver. workers = its descendants.
rc=1 on every run: pandas 3.0.5 has 679 failing tests on this machine under serial pytest too (same count under both runners).
Walls run above the published bench medians: a video call (Microsoft Teams, ~1.5 cores of WindowServer/camera/audio load) was active on the machine during these runs.
rstest commit cd0b03d + uncommitted working tree, rstest 0.8.0; pandas venv: CPython 3.13.13, pytest 9.1.1, pytest-xdist 3.8.0.
